description.purpose: The composite's ONE error drain port: the failure lanes of the brain and of the summarizer fan in here and leave as one normalised report on route error, so a parent tree drains a single edge instead of three.
description.use_when: Inside the talky composite. The parent MUST wire the exit somewhere - a log sink, an alarm, an operator surface; an unwired error lane dead-letters, which is loud but not actionable.
description.not_in_scope: No retry, no judgement, no swallowing: what a failure means is the parent's decision. Deliberately NOT a drain cell - a drain that ends inside the unit would make the failure invisible to the tree that owns the agent.
description.emits_meaning: route error: one report per failure, naming source (brain or summarizer), error code, session and turn. The report carries NO conversation content on purpose - the llm error lane echoes the PROMPT back, and a drain is not the place to file it.
description.consumes_meaning: the brain's error / content_filter emission (finish_reason on the hop) and the summarizer's summary_error emission (route on the hop). Anything else is reported as source unknown rather than swallowed.
examples: provider 500 at the brain -> one report, source brain, code error
empty summary at the close -> one report, source summarizer, code empty_summary
